verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents webhook subscriptions to specific triggering events, with full create, list, update and delete management. It also offers a Card Auth Loop endpoint that lets your own business logic accept or reject card transactions at authorization time. However, the rules and resulting actions must live in the customer's own code; there is no evidence of a native, user-definable rules engine. Missing for 10: native rule definition or automation builder, platform-executed actions on events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
